summary: Join specialized training on financial crime investigation and prosecution techniques. Equip yourself with the knowledge to tackle financial fraud effectively.
lede: Financial crime training helps investigators, compliance staff, auditors, and legal teams detect suspicious activity and support investigations. Participants learn to recognize transaction and behavioral red flags, trace financial flows through records, and collect, preserve, and document evidence. They also practice preparing clear case summaries, collaborating with prosecutors, and explaining findings in court.
audienceIntro: This course is aimed at professionals who regularly deal with financial crime risks, investigations, or case preparation.
audience: Compliance and risk managers in banks
Investigators in anti-corruption, anti-fraud, or financial crime
Regulators and supervisory staff in central banks
modules: Legal and Regulatory Frameworks for Financial Crime
Red Flags and Risk Indicators in Financial Transactions
Following the Money: Financial Analysis and Transaction Tracing
Building Strong Cases and Working with Prosecutors
Prosecution, Courtroom Procedures, and Testimony Preparation
Strengthening Prevention, Controls, and Organizational Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial transactions and crime investigation principles. Prior experience in compliance, risk management, or audit roles is beneficial but not required.
